enunciado: Implement a FIFO queue of capacity 4 with a circular array (front and rear indexes that wrap around with %). Enqueue 1, 2, 3, dequeue two, enqueue 4, 5, 6 and 7 (7 does not fit) and empty the queue showing the front index.
objetivos: Understand the FIFO policy (first in, first out)
Reuse array space with modular arithmetic
pistas: Keep an element counter to tell empty from full.
rear = (front + count) % CAP is where you enqueue.
